title: CATHAY GENERAL BANCORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Cathay General Bancorp, a regional bank headquartered in Los Angeles, filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026 announcing that its board of directors authorized a new share repurchase program of up to $150,000,000. The company has approximately 67,056,307 shares of common stock outstanding. The filing does not address market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Cathay General Bancorp board authorized share repurchases up to $150,000,000.
The company has approximately 67,056,307 shares of common stock outstanding.
Repurchases may be made on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions.
Repurchases may be made under a Rule 10b5-1 plan.
The program may be suspended, terminated, or modified at any time.
Signed by Albert J. Wang, Executive Vice President and CFO, dated April 23, 2026.
